name: toolshed-self
description: Toolshed introspection — discover available tools, search by name or description, view schemas, and invoke tools dynamically
health: curl -sf http://localhost:8081 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | jq -e '.result.tools | length > 0' >/dev/null

prefixes.description: List all tool server prefixes (e.g. gitlab, narsil, code-search). Each prefix groups related tools.

list.description: List all tools, or filter by prefix. Shows tool name and description.

search.description: Search tools by keyword in name or description.

schema.description: Show the full JSON schema for a specific tool, including all parameters.

call.description: Invoke a tool by name with named arguments.
